method: uniform random facts from kb.jsonl with source context (WikiBio infobox field + first sentence, 2017 lead, or source table row); each judged by hand by Claude against the source text and general knowledge; a fact counts as wrong if false, garbled, cut so it misleads, or a placeholder.

rounds.note: exploratory (first 500 of a 1,000 draw); led to fixes: name folding, list-cut descriptions, placeholder values, alma mater merges, lead title/subject mismatch, occupation splitting
exploratory; fixes: nationality whitelist, multi-period parties, ordinal descriptions, artist descriptor prefix

fixes to the responsible extractors: lead subject must contain every title word, 'history of'-type titles dropped, word-boundary cuts, more list modifiers; WikiBio date cross-check against the first sentence (31,398 conflicting infobox dates dropped), two-person entities skipped, 3-party merges rejected; WordNet attribution stripping; airport zero elevations dropped
